tasks.summary: Medusa turn-start «deal 1 damage to an opposing fighter in Medusa's zone» (no ability name field in capture) — optional owner-bound TARGET_FIGHTER pending, no auto-target, decline allowed. Arthur ability (no canonical name in capture; internal provisional label): attack-only face-down ability-BOOST committed at declaration per printed R-15 (attackValue stays printed; boostValue starts from the ability card, card BOOST adds later via post-reveal BOOST_CHOICE); Feint (CANCEL_EFFECTS) discards the ability boost without effect (R-16) while printed value remains; boost slots hidden from the non-attacker during COMBAT (filterPrivateData) and survive serialize (bv/cbc/abc).

tasks.title: Card BOOST timing correction (Second Shot / Noble Sacrifice, rulebook p.12-13)
tasks.summary: Official rulebook p.12-13: both players choose cards → simultaneous reveal → IMMEDIATELY effects → DURING_COMBAT effects (defender first). Second Shot / Noble Sacrifice print «DURING COMBAT: You may BOOST this attack» → choice happens AFTER reveal and Feint cancellation, NOT at declaration. Prior implementation committed the boost card in executeAttack — wrong (R-15 «along with your attack card» applies only to the Arthur ability). Now: executeAttack/playDefense drop boostCardId (no card leaves hand, no second-card disclosure to defender); BOOST effect PLAYER_CHOICE_HAND creates persisted owner-bound optional BOOST_CHOICE pending on the DURING_COMBAT stage; combat chain pauses (no damage calc / no after-combat) until resolvePendingEffect(cardIds — exactly one own hand card, atomic revalidation: foreign/not-in-hand/two-cards/stale/replay rejected) or declinePendingEffect; chosen card discarded, its boostValue added to combatEffectContinuation finalAttack/finalDefense (side from combatInfo.attackerId owner) and combatInfo boostValue/cardBoostCardId. Feint cancels the BOOST effect entirely (no choice, no cost); Arthur ability card stays committed at declaration (R-15) and is lost on Feint without value (R-16) — two independent boosts. Empty hand → legal no-op. AI: min-sufficient card or decline. Serialization roundtrip preserved.
